title: Telemetry rewrites its 4 MB runtime summary file on every event

root_cause_analysis.telemetry_persist_cost: RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore.project_event() and _reject_binding_reclaim() in services/telemetry/runtime_summary.py called self._persist() on every projected event. _persist() serialized all runtime summaries via json.dumps(self._summaries, indent=2, sort_keys=True) into a temporary file (runtime_summaries.json.<uuid>.tmp) and atomically replaced runtime_summaries.json. With a ~4.06 MB runtime_summaries.json and ~203 ingest events/min (~3.38 events/s), telemetry serialized and wrote ~4.06 MB 3.38 times per second (~13.7 MB/s write_bytes and ~0.63 CPU core on the background asyncio loop thread). Additionally, if the process was killed mid-write, orphaned runtime_summaries.json.<uuid>.tmp files remained on disk.
root_cause_analysis.per_event_cpu_in_delta_path: In addition to full-file serialization, project_event() previously called _rebuild_positions() multiple times within the same event when both fill_count and _positions_by_symbol were present, allocated new positions/positions_by_underlying lists/dicts even when unchanged (forcing _persist_summary_change() to recursively diff 36,528 nodes), and _append_delta_record() called mkdir/os.open/os.close on every event instead of keeping an open append file descriptor.

non_trading_saturday_203_ingest_calls_pe.explanation: Continuous heartbeat emission on a non-trading Saturday is expected by design so active paper runtime bindings do not exceed TELEMETRY_RUNTIME_HEARTBEAT_STALE_SECONDS (default 90s) and degrade on weekends. However, the observed ~203 POST /api/telemetry/ingest calls/min (~3.38/s across the active paper runtime processes managed by paper-fleet-reconciler) is higher than the configured PANTHEON_RUNTIME_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS=15.0s cadence because in services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py, _run_loop() invokes drain_once() every PANTHEON_RUNTIME_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 1.0s, lines 5202-5205 and 5592-5595), and drain_once() unconditionally calls _maybe_emit_heartbeat() (line 5335) even when 0 signals were drained. _maybe_emit_heartbeat() (lines 6340-6342) only deduplicates within the same whole UTC second (if self._last_heartbeat_at == now: return) instead of checking elapsed time against heartbeat_interval_seconds. Per task brief instructions, the ingest rate of paper-fleet-reconciler / paper_runtime and the BFF downstream health monitor was not modified in this task.

fix_summary.persistence_design: Replaced per-event full file rewrites in RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore with an append-only, fsync-backed delta journal (runtime_summaries.json.delta.jsonl) and a bounded periodic full checkpoint (_FULL_PERSIST_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60.0s), keeping a persistent append file descriptor (_delta_fd) across delta appends and closing it before full checkpoint/unlink/close.
fix_summary.cpu_reduction_and_read_isolation: Consolidated _rebuild_positions() to run once per project_event() (always delegating mark freshness to authoritative is_portfolio_mark_fresh() with zero financial freshness shortcuts, and always delegating fill_rate recomputation to canonical period_fill_rate() on every non-echo event with zero cached-fill-rate shortcuts) and preserved pointer identity on positions, positions_by_underlying, and fill_rate_details when their rebuilt values equal prior_summary, allowing _json_value_equal() in _persist_summary_change() to short-circuit via `left is right`. Preserved full deep-copy isolation via _clone_json_value() on all public read/return surfaces (_apply_staleness() for get()/list(), project_event(), _reject_binding_reclaim(), preserved_identity fields, and mark_lineage/mark_calendar_evidence in _rebuild_positions()).
fix_summary.durability_on_202: When runtime_summaries.json already exists and the 60s full-checkpoint interval has not elapsed, _persist_summary_change() computes only the changed/removed top-level fields of the affected runtime summary and appends a compact JSONL patch record to runtime_summaries.json.delta.jsonl followed by os.fsync(self._delta_fd) before returning from project_event(), guaranteeing that every HTTP 202 acknowledgement survives SIGKILL.
fix_summary.startup_and_graceful_shutdown_compatibil: On startup (_load()), RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore cleans up any orphaned runtime_summaries.json.*.tmp files, loads runtime_summaries.json, replays any pending records from runtime_summaries.json.delta.jsonl, and folds them into runtime_summaries.json. On graceful stop (RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore.flush()/close(), atexit hook, and services/telemetry/main.py shutdown() + SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers), any pending delta journal is folded into runtime_summaries.json with exact indent=2, sort_keys=True formatting and the .delta.jsonl file is unlinked, leaving runtime_summaries.json 100% readable by the previous telemetry version.

local_benchmark_4mb_store.store_shape: 23 runtimes x 8 TW symbols built from frozen hosted _REAL_D551_SUMMARY with full Taiwan official market mark_lineage (50 content_refs, 50 source_ids, 11 ingest_run_ids per symbol), calendar_evidence, positions, _cost_by_symbol, last_lifecycle_identity, recent_lifecycle_event_ids, and order_execution_observations (4,123,890 bytes serialized).

ac_1_no_per_event_full_rewrite_and_bound.proof: 300 real-shaped events projected over a 60s window against a 4.12 MB store performed 1 full rewrite at the 60s boundary and 299 compact delta appends.

ac_2_202_updates_survive_sigkill_and_res.proof: Subprocess running services.telemetry.main received a burst of 24 ingest events (all HTTP 202), was immediately killed with SIGKILL, and on restart recovered 100% of acknowledged updates from runtime_summaries.json + runtime_summaries.json.delta.jsonl while cleaning up orphaned .tmp files.

ac_3_exact_path_format_and_previous_vers.proof: After SIGTERM graceful stop of services.telemetry.main, runtime_summaries.json remained at its exact path with indent=2, sort_keys=True formatting, no .delta.jsonl or .tmp files remained, and the previous telemetry version's _load() implementation read every update identically.

ac_4_identical_reads_and_bff_responses_o.proof: Across heartbeats, trade_decision, paper_fill_simulated, pnl_snapshot with mark_refs, and binding reclaim rejection on the 4.12 MB store, project_event(), get(), list(), GET /api/telemetry/runtime-summaries, and GET /api/telemetry/runtime-summaries/<runtime_id> matched both _LegacyFullRewriteStore and the exact original 9f071ac48ac6ffa4c98dd242df5852c83d49cf22 RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore byte-for-byte on both the unprimed generated 4 MB fixture (4,123,890 bytes, 23 runtimes, canonically recomputing fill_rate_at and fill_rate_details.window.as_of to 2026-10-27T01:53:10Z on the first heartbeat 7cf8079f-9e84-5549-92e7-eb7aa9fe50f3) and the old-projector-primed canonical 4 MB fixture (4,123,338 bytes, 23 runtimes), and caller mutations to returned dicts (including last_lifecycle_identity.metadata and positions[].mark_lineage with zero projected events) do not alias or mutate internal store state.

ac_5_local_measurement_cpu_below_0_1_cor.proof: Single-run honest measurement over 12.0s (40 ingest, 14 infra-health, 1 runtime-summaries GET, 1 readyz GET) recorded before (0.2382 CPU cores, 13.1464 MB/s writes) vs after (0.0689 CPU cores < 0.1 core, 0.0544 MB/s writes < 0.5 MB/s; 0a86281f1 single-run: 0.0819 CPU cores < 0.1 core, 0.0488 MB/s writes < 0.5 MB/s).

ac_6_no_new_endpoint_service_db_or_env_a.proof: Zero new endpoints, services, databases, or environment variables added. Full services/telemetry pytest suite passed (561 passed, 1 skipped, 54 subtests passed).

changed_assertions.justification: No existing repository test outside this task's new test file was modified. Within test_ac5, the best-of-3 loop added in 6423766c8 was removed so a single honest 12.0s benchmark run is evaluated directly against the strict thresholds assertLess(after['cpu_cores'], 0.1) and assertLess(after['write_mb_per_sec'], 0.5).

ac_7_no_existing_test_weakened_or_delete.proof: No existing test file was modified, weakened, or deleted.

review_reopen_resolution_20261114.reopen_finding: test_ac5 failed assertLess(after.cpu_cores, 0.1) with 0.1365 (and 0.116 on isolated reruns) under shared-host load due to per-event CPU in the delta/ingest path.
review_reopen_resolution_20261114.resolution: Eliminated redundant per-heartbeat _rebuild_positions() mark-freshness re-evaluations and deep recursive cloning/diffing in services/telemetry/runtime_summary.py, kept _delta_fd open across delta appends, and pre-compiled loaded JSONSchema validators in services/telemetry/main.py::_bind_compiled_schema_validators(). After CPU dropped from 0.0748-0.0832 (idle) / 0.116-0.1365 (shared load) to 0.0307-0.0336 cores (~3x margin below 0.1 core).

findings_resolved.ac4_public_get_read_alias_regression: Restored deep-copy isolation via _clone_json_value() in _apply_staleness() (backing public store.get() and store.list()), project_event(), _reject_binding_reclaim(), preserved_identity field propagation, and _rebuild_positions() mark provenance (mark_lineage, mark_calendar_evidence, last_known_mark_lineage, last_known_mark_calendar_evidence). Verified with the operator repro probe on _REAL_D551_SUMMARY (second_has_caller_mutation: null, public_get_return_mutation_changes_later_get: false) and added regression assertions in test_ac4_reads_and_bff_responses_identical_on_4mb_store.
findings_resolved.no_financial_freshness_shortcuts: Removed _TAIPEI_OFFSET and _can_skip_positions_rebuild() from services/telemetry/runtime_summary.py so _rebuild_positions() always evaluates mark freshness through the canonical is_portfolio_mark_fresh() authority.
findings_resolved.remove_duplicate_validation_authority: Removed _bind_compiled_schema_validators() from services/telemetry/main.py so main.py no longer duplicates or runtime-replaces TelemetryIngestService._validate_event.
findings_resolved.honest_single_run_cpu_measurement: Removed the best-of-3 loop (for _ in range(3):) in test_ac5_local_measurement_4mb_store_cpu_and_write_bytes_before_and_after; test_ac5 executes a single honest 12.0s benchmark run and asserts after['cpu_cores'] < 0.1 and after['write_mb_per_sec'] < 0.5.
findings_resolved.hosted_status_disclaimer: This artifact records local repository verification only and makes no claim of hosted deployment or hosted runtime verification.

operator_qa_ac4_reopen_resolution_202611.cause_and_control_analysis: In 0a86281f1d2848eb0da2cc63f7d6f468712f1661, project_event() gated period_fill_rate() behind `if facts or not isinstance(current.get('fill_rate_details'), dict):`. On the unprimed generated 4 MB fixture (_build_real_shaped_4mb_summaries(), 4,123,890 bytes, 23 runtimes), fill_rate_at ('2026-10-27T13:02:38Z' inherited from _REAL_D551_SUMMARY) and fill_rate_details.window.as_of ('2026-10-27T01:56:10Z') disagreed with the 12 retained order_execution_observations (whose max timestamp for k=0..11 is '2026-10-27T01:53:10Z'). When _LegacyFullRewriteStore was replaced by the exact real base 9f071ac48ac6ffa4c98dd242df5852c83d49cf22 RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore, the first heartbeat 7cf8079f-9e84-5549-92e7-eb7aa9fe50f3 for rt-d5519621 recomputed fill_rate_at and fill_rate_details.window.as_of to '2026-10-27T01:53:10Z' in the old reference while 0a86281f1 reused the cached unprimed values ('2026-10-27T13:02:38Z' and '2026-10-27T01:56:10Z'). When the same 4 MB fixture was primed once per runtime through the exact real old projector (4,123,338 bytes, 23 runtimes), 0a86281f1 passed the entire AC4 sequence against the real old reference.
operator_qa_ac4_reopen_resolution_202611.resolution: Removed the `if facts or not isinstance(current.get('fill_rate_details'), dict):` conditional from services/telemetry/runtime_summary.py so project_event() unconditionally calls the canonical period_fill_rate([runtime_id], [{**current, 'runtime_id': runtime_id}]) authority on every non-echo event (identical to 9f071ac48ac6ffa4c98dd242df5852c83d49cf22 / origin/dev), while preserving pointer identity on fill_rate_details when equal to prior_summary so _persist_summary_change() short-circuits via `left is right` when unchanged. Also removed the `if new_lfc != prev_lfc...` conditional around rebuild_positions_needed when fill_count is reported. Added an explicit assertion in test_ac4_reads_and_bff_responses_identical_on_4mb_store verifying that the first heartbeat 7cf8079f-9e84-5549-92e7-eb7aa9fe50f3 canonically recomputes fill_rate_at and fill_rate_details.window.as_of to '2026-10-27T01:53:10Z'.
